content:
oncall_jordan: :rotating_light: PAGING: API gateway 502/504 spike in us-east-1. Error rate ~12% over last 5m, endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/chat most affected. Pager fired. Eng-sre + runtime please triage. thread_ts=1722223333

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1722223333. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apigw-5xx. Key metrics: 5xx-rate: 12.1%, median latency: 520ms, p95 latency: 2.4s. Alerting checks: upstream latency high to model-backend-pool-34.

ashley: I'm awake, on runtime. Any deploys in last 30m? also which edge region logs look noisy?

mike: No infra deploys in last hour. Observed TCP retransmits between edge-proxy and backend pool-34 starting ~1722223200. Trying to pull gateway pod logs.

mike: ran: ```kubectl -n gateway logs deploy/apigw -c proxy --since=10m | grep -E "502|504|upstream" | tail -n 50``` logs show repeated upstream timeout to 10.12.34.56: "upstream error: connection reset by peer"

ashley: Runtime metrics show KV-cache hit is normal. Traces point to increased connect latency to model-backend instances rather than model inference time. Looks like backend infra (pool-34) is flaking.

eli: I'm joining. Suggest immediate mitigation: enable per-route circuit breaker for /v1/generate to fail fast and route to fallback model variant or region. Also recommend throttling slow clients at the gateway to dampen retries.

cindy: Support seeing customer noise. CS ticket queue: CS-2456, CS-2457. Affected customers (high priority): AcmeCorp, BrightApps. They're seeing errors at high rate. Communicating: we will provide a 15m update.

ashley: Executing quick fallback: updating route for /v1/generate in us-east to use model-sm-1 (lighter variant) while pool-34 stabilizes. Command: ```redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --region us-east --model model-sm-1 --dry-run=false```

ops-bot: Scaling gateway pool: autoscaler override +4 instances in us-east triggered by manual request from oncall_jordan. New desired=12 -> applied.

mike: Also scaling model-backend pool-34 by +3 to try to absorb connections (kubectl scale deployment pool-34 --replicas=10). Watching for new pods readiness.

eli: Enabling a short circuit-breaker window on /v1/generate: ```POST /admin/circuit {"route":"/v1/generate","threshold":0.05,"window_s":60}``` This will fail fast 5xx after 5% failure in 60s to avoid backpressure cascading.

sre-bot: Telemetry: after mitigation steps (fallback + circuit + gateway scale), 5xx-rate dropped from 12.1% -> 3.2% in 4m. p95 latency improved to 350ms. Continuing to monitor.

oncall_jordan: Good reduction. Running impact assessment: customer error counts reduced by ~80% for AcmeCorp and BrightApps. Noting this for post-incident report.

cindy: Filing interim customer update: "We identified transient backend instability affecting model-serving pool in us-east. We’ve applied a temporary fallback and routing mitigations; errors are trending down. Will follow up with root cause and timeline for permanent fix." Sending now.

ashley: Collecting traces and preserving logs: please run these before we rotate pods: ```curl "https://telemetry.internal/query?from=1722223200&to=1722223600&service=apigw" > /tmp/apigw-spike.json``` and ```kubectl -n gateway get events --since=30m > /tmp/gateway-events.log```

mike: New backend pods are ready. I see reduced connect errors in proxy logs. Keeping the scale change for 20m, then will assess rollback.

eli: Plan for next 60m: 1) Keep fallback in place, 2) keep circuit-breaker active, 3) keep extra capacity, 4) gather traces + heap snapshots from model instances experiencing resets. Owners: ashley (runtime) for trace collection, mike (infra) for pod health, cindy (support) for customer comms.

oncall_jordan: Handoff: I'm preparing night-oncall summary in 10m. If anything spikes above 6% 5xx again, page the oncall roster immediately. Leaving clear playbook in INCIDENT doc. Current status: mitigations effective, partial customer impact, ongoing investigation.

ops-bot: Automated note: scheduled rollback of autoscaler override in 20m unless canceled by operator.

eli: Quick note for postmortem: capture kube-proxy logs on pool-34 nodes and network interface error counters. Suspect transient connection resets at the host/network layer.

oncall_jordan: All right — high-level update in 5m for execs. Team, great rapid response. I'll close the pager if rates stay <=4% for next 10m and handoff to night.

cindy: Confirmed: CS updated, response templates queued. Customers acknowledged and appreciate the quick mitigation.

sre-bot: Incident status: MONITORING -> under control. Next update window: 1732223433. Please annotate all actions in INC-2026-1722223333 timeline.

eli: Preserving artifacts: reminders to export traces, metrics, and proxy logs to /artifacts/INC-1722223333 before any pod restarts.

oncall_jordan: Last: turning on 30m elevated monitoring dashboard and will handoff in ~25m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
